acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given a `spec/components/{fileSlug}.md` file exists but fails `parseComponentDetail()`, when `pm-phase1`'s Tech-Spec generation runs its resume path, then the component is regenerated, not skipped
Given a `spec/components/{fileSlug}.md` file exists and parses successfully, when `pm-phase1`'s Tech-Spec generation runs its resume path, then the component is skipped, unchanged from today

Given a `spec/components/{fileSlug}.md` file is invalid, when `pm-phase1` is entered fresh (not mid-loop), then the outer regen gate notices the invalid file and triggers a resume pass for it, the same way it already does for a missing file

Given a `req/use-cases/{UC-ID}.md` file exists but does not start with that row's own `### {UC-ID}: ` heading, when `pm-phase1`'s Requirements generation runs its resume path, then the use case is regenerated, not skipped
Given a `req/use-cases/{UC-ID}.md` file exists and starts with the correct heading, when `pm-phase1`'s Requirements generation runs its resume path, then the use case is skipped, unchanged from today

Given a `wbs/tasks/{TASK_ID}.md` file exists with status `generated` but `parseTaskDetailBlock()` finds zero verification commands, when `pm-phase2`'s per-task generation runs, then the task is regenerated, not skipped
Given a `wbs/tasks/{TASK_ID}.md` file exists with status `generated` and at least one verification command, when `pm-phase2`'s per-task generation runs, then the task is skipped, unchanged from today

Given `--force` is passed, or a `needsRequirementsFix`/`needsTechSpecFix` revision cycle is active, when any of the three generation loops run, then every item is regenerated unconditionally, exactly as today
Given all changes are delivered, when `npm test` runs, then all tests pass: new regression tests for AC-01 through AC-07, and a full-suite regression
